messages:
Samir Khatri: Quick FYI — rolling release train update for the next 72h: we need a short, targeted partial freeze while infra finishes a DB migration rehearsal. TL;DR: block non-critical schema and API surface changes until Fri 16:00 UTC unless lifted early.

Jen Park: Copy. Can you add the explicit scope? i.e. allow hotpatches and security fixes, block feature/opt-in flags that touch storage or routing. I'll post the checklist in the release-docs thread.

Alex Mora: Infra note — we saw tail latency spikes on the embeddings path during canary 3.9.1 this morning (p95 up ~12%). I'm reserving 2 extra g4 pools and increasing scale_up_buffer from 3 -> 5 for the freeze window. This should keep canaries isolated.

deploy-bot: Notice: non-critical PRs labeled `deploy:blocked-freeze` will be auto-held by the release pipeline until the freeze is lifted. Use label `deploy:hotpatch` for emergency fixes.

Lina Gomez: Heads-up to partner teams: small throughput regressions possible during the migration rehearsal. I'll send a short note to the integrators list and add a line to the status page.

Samir Khatri: Canary snapshot at 10:34 UTC: embedding service p50 28ms, p95 jumped from 180ms -> 202ms. Error rate steady. Logs show a couple of timeouts on model-loader during warmup.

Alex Mora: Quick debug command if you want to poke logs:
```bash
kubectl -n canary logs -l app=embedder --since=15m | egrep "95th|timeout|model-loader" -A2
```
Results retained in /var/logs/canary/2026-03-23/embedder-check.log for 48h.

Jen Park: Rollback/abort criteria (added to the runbook): auto-rollback if error rate > 0.5% OR p95 > baseline +200ms sustained for 10 minutes. Oncall to confirm before manual rollouts otherwise.

Maya Rivera (oncall): I'll shadow canary dashboards and set an alert rule mirroring the rollback criteria. If triggered, I'll page the release channel and set the deployment to stop.

Samir Khatri: Proposed freeze lift: Fri 16:00 UTC *if* canary stable for a continuous 24h window. If not, we'll extend in +24h increments after a quick sync. Please thumbs-up here if you agree. :thumbsup:

Jen Park: +1 — posting quick summary to #product and #customer-ops, linking this thread.

Lina Gomez: +1 from partner comms.

Alex Mora: +1. Will attach canary dashboards to the release doc.

deploy-bot: Automated reminder scheduled: will post a status update at 2h intervals to this thread until freeze is lifted.

Samir Khatri: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short exec note if anything changes.
